intent: Track what AI APIs, GPU clouds and developer platforms actually cost across regions: models, plans, per-unit prices, currencies and limits.

fields.name: model_name
fields.description: The AI model's full name as listed on the pricing page, e.g. in the model pricing table or cards

fields.name: input_price_per_1m
fields.description: Price in USD per 1 million input tokens, numeric only without the dollar sign

fields.name: output_price_per_1m
fields.description: Price in USD per 1 million output tokens, numeric only without the dollar sign

fields.name: category
fields.description: The model type or category label if shown, such as text generation or embeddings

fields.name: model_name
fields.description: The AI model's full name as listed in the pricing tables

fields.name: input_price_per_1m_tokens
fields.description: Price in USD per 1 million input tokens, numeric only

fields.name: output_price_per_1m_tokens
fields.description: Price in USD per 1 million output tokens, numeric only

fields.name: model_category
fields.description: Model family or section heading the model appears under

fields.name: plan_name
fields.description: The plan tier name shown on the pricing card, like Hobby or Pro

fields.name: monthly_price
fields.description: The plan's monthly price in USD, numeric only without the dollar sign

fields.name: description
fields.description: The short plan description or usage allowance shown on the card

fields.name: tier_name
fields.description: The model or model-size tier named in the pricing table rows

fields.name: input_price
fields.description: Price in USD per 1 million input tokens for this row, numeric only

fields.name: price_unit_description
fields.description: What the price is charged per, like $ / 1M input tokens

fields.name: gpu_type
fields.description: The GPU or instance type name in the on-demand pricing table

fields.name: price_per_gpu_per_hour
fields.description: On-demand hourly price per GPU in USD, numeric only

fields.name: gpu_count
fields.description: Number of GPUs in the instance if shown

fields.name: resource
fields.description: The compute resource being priced, like a GPU model or CPU or memory

fields.name: price
fields.description: The listed price as a number, without currency symbol

fields.name: unit
fields.description: The billing unit the price applies to, like per second or per hour
